name: smwgraphics-super-paper-mario-gloam-valley
title: Super Paper Mario - Gloam Valley
description:
A custom-made background that's made to look a lot like Gloam Valley, World 2-1 from Super Paper Mario. I highly recommend this one, it's great! Please give credit, and more importantly, PLEASE read the readme.

Also, this makes sure the background doesn't turn scary when you complete a level, and it adds a new object!
